FOUNDING WRITERS

How it works

As one of our first 100 writers, you’re helping build QueryHawk. Everything useful you tell us is a contribution, and contributions move you up through the flock, from Fledgling to QueryHawk.

The flock

  1. Fledgling1+ contributionsJust hatched, and already helping.
  2. Archivist3+ contributionsKeeps the record straight.
  3. Scout8+ contributionsSpots what others miss.
  4. Mentor15+ contributionsHelps shape how every writer queries.
  5. QueryHawk25+ contributionsTop of the tree.

What counts

Answering the question of the week1
Reporting a problem we can confirm1
Telling us something’s unclear1
Suggesting an idea1
Telling us what works1
An idea of yours that we build+3

The fair-play rules

  • Up to 3 a week count. Send as much as you like. We read it all, but only three a week move you up.
  • A sentence or more, in your own words. One-word notes and repeats of the same point don’t count.
  • It counts once we’ve read it. Usually within a few days; until then it shows as waiting.
  • One answer per weekly question.
  • Your level never goes down. Take a month off; your hawk will wait.

You give feedback from Give feedback in the sidebar, or by answering the question of the week.
